supports: United States Attorney Daniel N. Rosen announced that Abdirashid Bixi Dool, 36, pleaded guilty on July 13, 2026 to one count of wire fraud for his role in a Feeding Our Future scheme involving more than $330,000.
USAO-MN described Dool as the 68th Feeding Our Future defendant convicted.
Dool faces a maximum statutory penalty of 20 years in prison; sentencing had not yet been scheduled as of this release.

According to court documents cited in the release, from about March 2021 through December 2021 Dool and co-conspirators submitted fraudulent reimbursement claims on behalf of two Minnesota nonprofits, Bilaal Mosque, Inc. and Multicultural Resource Center, Inc., which purported to run meal sites in Pelican Rapids and Moorhead, Minnesota.

The release states Bilaal and MRC claimed to have served over 505,000 meals to children between approximately March 2021 and February 2022, and that the Minnesota Department of Education paid nearly $1.1 million in federal child-nutrition funds to the two entities based on the fraudulent submissions.
